title: LayoutPack Command
description: Create A3 landscape Layout pages. Each page has one parallel Detail of the clay and a title block at the bottom-right. Does not use Make2D curves.

views.description: Views to lay out, in order. Default plan, north, east, south, west.

scale.description: Requested detail scale denominator. 100 means 1:100. Bumped if the clay does not fit the detail.

replace.description: Delete existing Forsk Layout pages for those views before creating them.
